title: Exterior / Glitch cube sign
slide_intent: Use a compact symbol where a full name would be awkward so identification remains clear from multiple directions.
strategic_value: Repeating Glitch on two faces of a purple projecting sign can extend Twitch recognition into physical space.
demonstration: A purple cube-like sign projects from a stone facade with Glitch on both visible faces beneath a colored window.
practical_value: Compare symbol placement on adjacent faces and its relationship to the building.

content_islands.name: Projecting sign
content_islands.spec: Place the purple sign outward from the facade, repeating the white-and-black symbol on both visible faces.

content_islands.name: Architectural context
content_islands.spec: Retain the stone joints and colored window above to show mounting and scale.

reference_purposes.Application: Glitch is applied to a projecting exterior sign visible from two directions.
